First, convert 36 weeks and 4 days to days:  
36 weeks = 36 × 7 = 252 days  
Add 4 days → 256 days total to subtract.

Date given: 1278-08-21 (assuming format is MM-DD-YYYY, so August 21, 1278).  
Subtract 256 days:  
August has 31 days, so go back to July:  
256 − 21 = 235 days remaining to go back from August 1, 1278.  

July 1278 has 31 days → 235 − 31 = 204 (now at July 1, 1278 → June 1, 1278 after subtracting 30 days? Let’s proceed systematically):

Better:  
From 1278-08-21, subtract 21 days → 1278-07-31.  
Remaining: 256 − 21 = 235 days.  

July 1278: 31 days → 235 − 31 = 204 (now at 1278-06-30).  
June 1278: 30 days → 204 − 30 = 174 (now at 1278-05-31).  
May 1278: 31 days → 174 − 31 = 143 (now at 1278-04-30).  
April 1278: 30 days → 143 − 30 = 113 (now at 1278-03-31).  
March 1278: 31 days → 113 − 31 = 82 (now at 1278-02-28? 1278 is not a leap year (divisible by 2 but not by 4 in Gregorian? Actually 1278 mod 4 = 2, so not leap).  
February 1278: 28 days → 82 − 28 = 54 (now at 1278-01-31).  
January 1278: 31 days → 54 − 31 = 23 (now at 1277-12-31).  
December 1277: 31 days → but we only need to go back 23 days from 1277-12-31:  
31 − 23 = 8 → so date is 1277-12-08.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1277-12-08
